title: CHAPTER 9: CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN MAHARASHTRA

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tracks key political shifts, administrative changes, and policy developments in Maharashtra.
Highlights prestigious honors, national awards, and state-level achievements by notable personalities.
Details significant sports developments, state athletes, and major tournament occurrences.
Examines occurrences of natural disasters, relief operations, and disaster preparedness in the state.

blocks.content: Maharashtra has witnessed significant administrative and political changes in recent years. The following are key developments candidates should be aware of for competitive exams:
CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN MAHARASHTRA

items: Aurangabad district renamed to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (2023)
Navi Mumbai International Airport: Construction underway at Ulwe; named after Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
Samruddhi Mahamarg (Mumbai-Nagpur Expressway): Largely operational (2022-2023); 701 km; 16 districts connected
Mumbai Coastal Road Project: Under construction; will connect Marine Lines to Worli; reduces traffic
Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (Atal Setu): Longest sea bridge in India; opened in January 2024; connects Mumbai to Navi Mumbai; 21.8 km
Metro Rail Expansion: Multiple Metro lines operational in Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur
Nagpur Metro: Extended to Hingna and Automotive Square (2023)
Pune Metro: Phase 1 fully operational; Phase 2 under progress

cells: Several eminent personalities from Maharashtra have been honored with Padma awards annually
Bhalchandra Nemade (2014) was the most recent Marathi Jnanpith awardee
Highest civilian award of Maharashtra state; given annually
Several Marathi authors win national Sahitya Akademi award annually
Mumbai and Pune are major cricket centers; Wankhede Stadium (Mumbai), MCA Stadium (Pune)
Maharashtra has strong tradition of Kushti (wrestling); Kolhapur's Lal Maati famous

items: MPSC exams frequently test recent recipients of Maharashtra Bhushan and Padma awards from the state.
Administrative committees, new policy notifications, and sports achievements are high-yield topics for state civil services.
